title: fix: execute detached generations at most once
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Claims a detached job before calling the provider
- Fails and clears an interrupted alarm instead of executing the generation again
- Adds coordinator regression coverage for alarm redelivery

Alternative root-cause fix to #13622: this prevents duplicate provider execution while keeping alarms for their independent timeout.

Tests:
- 11 focused coordinator and generation-deduplication tests
- Gen TypeScript check
- Biome and diff checks

gist.headline: One job, one bloom
gist.blurb: Detached generations now get claimed before they visit a provider. If an old alarm wakes up late, it tidies itself away instead of asking for the same flowers twice.
gist.summary: GenerationCoordinator now claims detached jobs before provider execution and clears interrupted redelivered alarms, ensuring each detached generation runs at most once while alarms retain their independent timeout role.
gist.impact: Users get more reliable detached generations: an alarm redelivery will no longer trigger a duplicate provider call for work that has already been claimed.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful garden coordinator placing a single claim tag on one glowing code-seed before it is delivered to a retro provider terminal. A sleepy alarm clock tries to ring again in the background, but Polli gently clears it while a single healthy code-flower blooms, representing exactly-once detached generation execution.
